name: Convivial Content
description: Fetches YAML datasets from a configurable source URL and imports them as Drupal content (taxonomy, media, block content, nodes, paragraphs, menus, blocks, site settings) for the Convivial distribution.
project_description:
It ships default content for the convivial profile.

 Requirements 
 This module requires the following modules:

 
 Convivial Core 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further information, see Installing Drupal Modules .

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 
 Enable the module at Administration > Extend 
 Go to Administration > Configuration > Convivial CXP > Content Import > Convivial Content 
 Configure the Source URL to fetch the source content 
 Go to Administration > Configuration > Convivial CXP > Content Import 
 Select the dataset and import the content 
 
 Back to top 

 FAQ 
 Q: Why is importing not working with the Authenticated user?

A: The import requires high-level permissions, so always perform imports with the site administrator role.
